SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
S. I. Station,
Date February 21, 1931.

Subject (in full)   allegations against S.D. J. 173 Liang Mou-liang (      ).

Made by   D.S. Holder        Forwarded by

The above case came before the Procurators at 3 p.m.
on the 11.2.31 when after hearing the evidence of two sides the
Procurator remanded the case 'sine die'.

Prior to the case coming up in Court S.D. J. 176
Liang Mou-liang (      ) was closely questioned regarding the
allegations made against him. He stated that he had nothing
to add other than that which he had given in his statement which
was taken immediately after the allegation was made in Court.

Three Van or (      ) Station No. 3343 J.R.P. well
794, after being sentenced to three and a half years' imprisonment
appealed. At the second hearing of the appeal, he stated that
S.D. J. 173 upon arresting him at 10 p.m. on the 1.11.30 had taken
from him $100.00, one gold ring and one pair of ear rings which
the S.D. stated he would give to the accused's mother. The
property was reputed to have been handed over after the S.D. J.
had informed the accused that all property found on the accused
would be confiscated at the Station.

The day following the Appeal Court Hearing the S.D. J.
was called to Tulling Well Station where he made a statement
denying all and every allegation stating that he had
never taken anything from the accused. Inquiries were made
in the vicinity where the arrest took place but no evidence
could be obtained such as eyewitnesses etc. The case came
up for judgment in the following week when the undersigned gave
such information as had been obtained in evidence before the
Court. The accused on this occasion made no further remark
re the alleged theft, and his sentence was reduced to one year.

The procurator however ordered that a further
investigation be made into the case as the S.D. J. was reputed

报告
静安寺捕房，
日期：1931年2月21日。

主题（全称）   针对华探员 J. 173 梁某良 (      ) 的指控。

呈报人   侦探警长 Holder        转呈人

上述案件于1931年2月11日下午3时提堂审理，检察官在听取双方证词后，将案件“无限期延期”（sine die）。

在案件上庭之前，华探员 J. 176 梁某良 (      ) 就针对他的指控接受了严密讯问。他表示，除了在法庭提出指控后立即录取的供词外，他没有什么可补充的。

三名凡（Van）或 (      ) 站3343号 J.R.P. 井794号，在被判处三年半监禁后提出上诉。在上诉第二次聆讯时，他陈述称，华探员 J. 173 于1930年11月1日晚上10点逮捕他时，从他身上拿走了100.00元、一枚金戒指和一对耳环，该探员声称会将这些物品交给被告的母亲。据称，在华探员 J. 告知被告在捕房发现的所有财物将被没收后，这些财物才被移交。

上诉法院聆讯后的第二天，该华探员 J. 被召至提篮桥捕房，他作出一份声明，否认所有指控，声称从未从被告处拿走任何东西。在逮捕发生地附近进行了调查，但未能获得如目击证人等证据。案件于次周开庭判决，签署人在法庭上提交了已获取的证据信息。被告此次未就所谓盗窃一事发表进一步评论，其刑期减为一年。

然而，检察官命令对该案进行进一步调查，因为据称该华探员 J. 涉及

to have been concerned in an extortion and assault which occurred
in connection with the above case.
The case was only before the Procurator's Court for
investigation and was remanded until 5 p.m. 19.3.31.
The convict averred that he had written a letter from the
Jail to his brother informing him that he had given the
previously described property to S.D. 178 and asked whether the
property had been given over to the custody of the accused's
mother.
When the case was before the Court on the 19.3.31 the
mother of Tse Yuen Mr produced a letter written by the accused
from the Jail in which it stated that the property aforementioned
had been handed over to Liang Hsueh-ling. This letter was
written on a Municipal Jail letter form dated from the Jail
on the 1.1.31. No mention was made in the letter that
Liang Hsueh-ling was in the employ of the Municipal Police
therefore the Jail authorities saw no reason why it should not
be forwarded to the address given.
Tse Yuen or the convict Shao was interviewed at the
Central Police Station between 10 a.m. and 11 a.m. on the 20.3.31 when
he gave the following information :-
"My wife had fallen sick some days before the incident
occurred which caused my arrest and I to be sent to hospital.
I sent her to the French Hospital in the Chinese City. Owing
to the seriousness of her illness I borrowed $100.00 from my
brother-in-law one Liu Chi Foo (______) who resides at the
West Gate City (Pien Kwei Foo gave evidence of the loan in
Court on the 19.3.31) on the 30.10.30. After going to the
hospital to visit my wife I returned to brother-in-law's

该案仅在检察官法庭进行调查，并延期至1931年3月19日下午5时。
罪犯声称，他从监狱给兄弟写了一封信，告知他已将前述财物交给华探员 178，并询问财物是否已移交给被告母亲保管。
当案件于1931年3月19日在法庭审理时，谢元先生（Tse Yuen Mr）的母亲出示了一封由被告从监狱写出的信，信中称前述财物已交给梁学林（Liang Hsueh-ling）。这封信写在市政监狱的信笺上，日期为1931年1月1日，发自监狱。信中未提及梁学林受雇于工部局警务处，因此监狱当局认为没有理由不将其转发至所给的地址。
谢元或罪犯邵（Shao）于1931年3月20日上午10时至11时间在新闸路中央捕房接受问询，他提供了以下信息：
“在我被捕并被送往医院的事件发生前几天，我妻子生病。我将她送到华界的法国医院。由于病情严重，我于1930年10月30日向住在西门城（West Gate City）的姐夫刘奇福（Liu Chi Foo，______）借了100.00元（边贵福 Pien Kwei Foo 于1931年3月19日在法庭上就借款作证）。去医院探望妻子后，我回到姐夫的

house where I slept on the night of that day. On the following
day I went to my brother-in-law's house with intent
to return to my home in Ahimsa Road but when I got on a bus at the
Great World I met Liang _________ S.D.D. 176, who informed me
that he was going to arrest me. The bus stopped at the
corner of Gordon Road and Avenue Joffre we both alighted and
the S.D.D. told me to go with him to the Station. We went
along Gordon Road and thence went along Bubbling Well Road
as we arrived about midway between Gordon Road and Hart Road
on Bubbling Well Road the S.D.D. turned round and produced a
pistol telling me that if I had anything of value I was
to hand it over to him and that he would give it to my mother.
I handed over $140.00, one gold ring and one pair of ear rings,
We then proceeded to the Station. On arrival there I was taken
to the Detective Office where I was kept for some time and
questioned by a Foreigner (the undersigned J.C. Golay). Later I
was taken to the H.P. room and searched and afterwards sent to
Roads end Station where I was detained until I was taken before
the Court. I did not say anything about the property as I
thought that I ought to give it to my mother. I have known
Liang Chen-liang for some 3 months and have met him on a number
of occasions".

（批：seems rather far fetched if he was giving & handing the property over to his mother. 21/2/31）

Liang Chen-liang now admits that he had in his possession some
$11.00 in notes and small change which were found in his search
of property together with other small possessions. When interviewed
at the Trial, he was asked why he did not give this remaining
sum to the Executive seeing that he had promised to hand everything
over to the arrested man's mother, he replied that he thought
the S.D.D. had overlooked it when searching him.

家中，当晚就在那里过夜。第二天，我前往姐夫家，打算返回我在爱文义路（Ahimsa Road）的家，但当我在大世界（Great World）登上公交车时，遇到了华探员 D.D. 176 梁 _________，他告诉我他要逮捕我。公交车停在戈登路（Gordon Road）和霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的拐角处，我们两人都下了车，该华探员 D.D. 让我跟他去捕房。我们沿着戈登路走，然后转入静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road），当我们走到静安寺路上戈登路和赫德路（Hart Road）之间的大约中途位置时，该华探员 D.D. 转过身，掏出手枪，告诉我说，如果我有任何贵重物品，必须交给他，他会转交给我母亲。我交出了140.00元、一枚金戒指和一对耳环。随后我们前往捕房。到达后，我被带到探员办公室，在那里待了一段时间，并由一名外国人（即下文签署人 J.C. Golay）进行讯问。后来我被带到人身搜查室（H.P. room）进行搜身，之后被送往极司菲尔路捕房（Roads end Station），在那里被拘留，直到被带上法庭。我没有提及财物的事，因为我认为应该把它给我母亲。我认识梁陈良（Liang Chen-liang）大约3个月，并曾多次见过面”。

（批注：如果他是为了把财物交给他母亲，这说法似乎有些牵强。1931年2月21日）

梁陈良现在承认，在他被搜查财物时，除了其他小件物品外，还发现他持有约11.00元的纸币和零钱。在审讯期间接受问询时，有人问他既然承诺将所有东西交给被捕者的母亲，为何不将这笔余款交给行政人员，他回答说他认为华探员 D.D. 在搜身时漏掉了这笔钱。

I submit that as the detective and Tanco Van der were friendly
and the fact that Tanco has stated that I.D.J.176 promised to
hand over the property to Tanco's mother he would more likely
have handed over the $11.0 to the detective rather than take
the chance of losing it when being searched at the Station.
Further as Tanco Van der admits that I.D.J.176 promised to
hand over the property, it is rather unlikely that it would be
necessary for him to hold the arrested man up at the point of
pistol to obtain the property.
E. M. Goege
D. S.

Dated 9th January, 20th Year of

Dear Brother Van An,
Owing to having committed crime I have been

I have handed to Liang Nyoh Liang dollars

Date January 25th. 1931

Subject (in full) Reference attached statement made by C.D.C.176.

Made by D.S. Golder. Forwarded by ____________________

Sir:-
    With reference to the attached statement.
    On the night of the 31-10-30 I was in the Station Canteen.
    At about 10.10 p.m. C.D.C.176 opened the door and stated that
he had made an arrest and that the arrested man was in the
Detective Office. I went to the office and there saw Tshoe Van
Er who was wanted on Shanghai Special District Court Warrant for
(assault causing death);
    I conveyed the import of the Warrant to the arrested man
through the C.D.C. asked him a few questions relative to the case
and then took him to the Charge Room, from where he was sent to
Gordon Road.
    I can vouch that nothing was taken from the man while he was
in the station as he was in my presence the whole time until he
was taken to the Charge Room.

                                (Signature)
                                D.S. 118.

报告

静安寺捕房，
日期：1931年1月25日

主题（全称） 参见附上的华探员 C.D.C.176 所作的陈述。

呈报人 侦探警长 Golder。 转呈人 ____________________

先生：
    关于附件中的陈述。
    1930年10月31日晚，我在捕房食堂。
    晚上约10点10分，华探员 C.D.C.176 打开门，声称
他已实施逮捕，被捕者在探员办公室。我前往办公室，在那里看到了谢万尔（Tshoe Van Er），上海特区法院因（伤害致死）对他发出了通缉令；
    我通过该华探员向被告传达了通缉令的内容，询问了他几个与案件相关的问题，然后将他带到收押室，随后他被送往戈登路捕房。
    我可以证明，该男子在捕房期间未被拿走任何物品，因为在他被带到收押室之前，他一直在我视线范围内。

                                （签名）
                                侦探警长 118。

Form 40
G. 10 m-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Liang Yue Liang,
native of ____________________ taken by me D.S. Golder.
at B'Well on the 25-1-31 and interpreted by C.S. Sih.

My name is Liang Yue Liang, employed by Shanghai Municipal
Police as a Chinese Detective Constable, No.176. On the 31-10-30,
Foreign Detective Sergeant 118 told me to make enquiries about
Tshoe Van Er at Annam & Hardon Roads. At 10 p.m. on the 31-10-30
I saw Tshoe Van Er come from the Route 9 Bus at Avenue Foch and
Hardon Road. I approached, asked him whether his name was Tshoe
Van Er, which he admitted and asked me who I was? I replied to
him that I was a Bubbling Well Police Detective. When he heard
this, he tried to make his escape and so I took out my pistol and
told him that I would shoot him if he tried to escape. I then
took him to the Bubbling Well Police Station. At that time,
D.S.118 was in the canteen and I went there and told him that
Tshoe Van Er was arrested and brought to the Station. D.S.118
followed me to the Detective Office. I didn't search any notes
or any gold rings from him which (D.S.118 can give evidence).
This is my true statement.

(Signed) Liang Yue Liang,
C.D.C.176.
Witness C.D.S.139.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下是梁岳良（Liang Yue Liang）的陈述，
籍贯 ____________________，由我，侦探警长 Golder，
于1931年1月25日在静安寺捕房录取，由华文书记 Sih 翻译。

我叫梁岳良，受雇于上海公共租界工部局警务处，任华探员，编号176。1930年10月31日，洋探员警长118号命我去安南路和赫顿路（Hardon Roads）调查谢万尔（Tshoe Van Er）。1930年10月31日晚上10点，我看见谢万尔从福煦路（Avenue Foch）和赫顿路的9路公交车上下来。我走近，问他是否叫谢万尔，他承认了，并问我是谁？我回答他说我是静安寺捕房的探员。听到这话，他试图逃跑，于是我掏出手枪，告诉他如果试图逃跑我就开枪。随后我将他带到静安寺捕房。当时，侦探警长118号在食堂，我去那里告诉他谢万尔已被逮捕并带到捕房。侦探警长118号跟随我来到探员办公室。我没有从他身上搜出任何纸币或金戒指（侦探警长118号可以作证）。这是我的真实陈述。

（签名）梁岳良，
华探员 C.D.C.176。
见证人 华探员警长 C.D.S.139。
